note: Blessing post, Psalm 115:14-15, 2 slides, no redraws
caption:
A blessing for your week. Send it to someone you are praying for.

This is a prayer for growth and good things, for you and for the ones you love, from the One who made heaven and earth. Pass it to someone who could use a quiet word of blessing today.

Psalm 115:14-15 (BSB)

Keep this one close.
